images.caption: Macanao Peninsula is a virtually untouched area of Margarita Island and almost uninhabited. There are many endangered species in this area, as Amazona barbadensis. The main problem in recent years is the pollution caused by waste dumped from fishing boats and debris left on beaches by residents.
images.alt: Macanao Peninsula is a virtually untouched area of Margarita Island and almost uninhabited. There are many endangered species in this area, as Amazona barbadensis. The main problem in recent years is the pollution caused by waste dumped from fishing boats and debris left on beaches by residents.
